parameters.help_en: The code of service. You can query the service code by calling the QueryProductList operation or viewing Codes of Alibaba Cloud Services
parameters.help_zh: 产品代码，可通过接口QueryProductList查询产品代码，或查看阿里云产品Code速查手册
parameters.name: product_code

parameters.help_en: The type of the resource plan. The value must be the same as the value of the ProductCode parameter that is returned when you call the DescribeResourcePackageProduct operation
parameters.help_zh: 资源包类型。值与描述资源包接口返回的ResourcePackage的Code值相等
parameters.name: package_type

parameters.help_en:
The time when the resource plan takes effect. If you do not specify this parameter, the resource plan immediately takes effect by default.
When the OrderType is BUY, resource packs with the EffectiveDate longer than the current time of 6 months are not supported.
If the OrderType is UPGRADE, the EffectiveDate must be less than or equal to the actual expiration time of the upgraded instance.
Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddThh:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh:
资源包生效时间，不填默认立即生效。
订单类型为购买时，不支持询价生效时间大于当前时间六个月的资源包。
订单类型为升级时，生效时间必须小于等于升级的资源包实际到期时间。
日期格式按照ISO8601标准表示，并需要使用UTC时间。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: effective_date

parameters.help_en: The specifications of the resource plan
parameters.name: specification

parameters.help_en: The validity period of the resource plan. The value must be the same as the duration of the resource plan specified in the specifications
parameters.help_zh: 资源包时长。值与规格大小的可用时长相符
parameters.name: duration

parameters.help_en:
The unit of validity period of the resource plan. Valid values:

Month

Year
parameters.help_zh:
资源包时长单位。取值：
Month：月。
Year：年
parameters.name: pricing_cycle

parameters.help_en:
The type of the order. Valid values:

BUY: You place the order to purchase an instance.

UPGRADE: You place the order to upgrade an instance.

RENEW: You place the order to renew an instance.

Default value: BUY
parameters.help_zh:
订单类型，取值：
BUY：新购。
UPGRADE：升级。
RENEW：续费。

默认值BUY
parameters.name: order_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the instance. This parameter is required when the order type is renewal or upgrade
parameters.help_zh: 用户实例ID。订单类型为续费、升级时，必填
parameters.name: instance_id
